description: Defines logger classes for procedures and UE procedures within the ocudu namespace, including methods for logging procedure start, progress, failure, and completion, utilizing external logging and formatting utilities.

classes.name: du_procedure_logger
classes.description: Logger class for general procedure events, providing methods to log start, progress, failure, and completion.

classes.name: ue_procedure_logger
classes.description: Logger class for UE-specific procedures, including UE index and RNTI information, with methods for logging start, progress, failure, and warnings.

methods.name: log_proc_started
methods.description: Logs the start of a procedure.

methods.name: log_progress
methods.description: Logs progress messages with formatted arguments.

methods.name: log_proc_completed
methods.description: Logs the successful completion of a procedure.

methods.name: log_proc_failure
methods.description: Logs a procedure failure with a reason.

methods.name: log_proc_warning
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to UE procedures.

methods.name: log_impl
methods.description: Internal method to perform the actual logging with a specified log channel and message.
